command:
index=entra_id sourcetype=entra:audit earliest=0 result=success
(activityDisplayName="*app role assignment to service principal*" OR activityDisplayName="*delegated permission grant*")
| eval operation=trim(activityDisplayName)
| where operation IN ("Add app role assignment to service principal","Add delegated permission grant")
| eval id=trim(id)
| spath path=initiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName output=actor_user
| spath path=initiatedBy.app.displayName output=actor_app
| eval actor=case(isnotnull(actor_user) AND actor_user!="null" AND actor_user!="",actor_user,isnotnull(actor_app) AND actor_app!="null" AND actor_app!="",actor_app,true(),"unknown")
| eval missing_id=if(isnull(id) OR id="" OR id="null",1,0)
| eval event_id=if(missing_id=1,"missing:".sha256(_raw),id)
| spath path=targetResources{} output=target
| eval target=coalesce(target,"{}")
| mvexpand target
| eval target_key=sha256(target)
| spath input=target path=id output=resource_sp_id
| eval resource_sp_id=trim(resource_sp_id)
| eval resource_sp_id=if(resource_sp_id="" OR lower(resource_sp_id)="null",null(),resource_sp_id)
| spath input=target path=displayName output=resource_name
| spath input=target path=modifiedProperties{} output=property
| eval property=coalesce(property,"{}")
| mvexpand property
| spath input=property path=displayName output=property_name
| spath input=property path=newValue output=new_value
| eval property_value=trim(trim(new_value),"\"")
| eval property_value=trim(property_value)
| eval property_value=if(property_value="" OR property_value="null",null(),property_value)
| eval grant_marker=if(property_name IN ("AppRole.Id","AppRole.Value","DelegatedPermissionGrant.Scope","DelegatedPermissionGrant.ConsentType"),1,0)
| stats
    earliest(_time) AS _time
    values(actor) AS actor
    values(operation) AS operation
    values(correlationId) AS correlationId
    max(missing_id) AS missing_id
    max(grant_marker) AS grant_marker
    values(resource_sp_id) AS resource_sp_id
    values(resource_name) AS resource_name
    values(eval(if(property_name="ServicePrincipal.ObjectID",property_value,null()))) AS client_sp_id
    values(eval(if(property_name="AppRole.Value",property_value,null()))) AS app_permissions
    values(eval(if(property_name="DelegatedPermissionGrant.Scope",property_value,null()))) AS delegated_scopes
    values(eval(if(property_name="DelegatedPermissionGrant.ConsentType",property_value,null()))) AS consent_type
  BY event_id target_key
| eventstats max(grant_marker) AS event_has_grant BY event_id
| where grant_marker=1 OR event_has_grant=0
| eval ambiguous=if(coalesce(mvcount(client_sp_id),0)!=1 OR coalesce(mvcount(resource_sp_id),0)!=1 OR coalesce(mvcount(operation),0)!=1,1,0)
| eval client_sp_id=lower(coalesce(mvindex(client_sp_id,0),"__missing__"))
| eval resource_sp_id=lower(coalesce(mvindex(resource_sp_id,0),"__missing__"))
| eval grant_type=if(operation="Add delegated permission grant","delegated","application")
| eval permission=if(grant_type="application",app_permissions,split(replace(trim(mvjoin(delegated_scopes," ")),"[[:space:]]+"," ")," "))
| eval permission=coalesce(permission,"__missing__")
| eval consent_type=if(grant_type="application","not_applicable",coalesce(consent_type,"__missing__"))
| mvexpand permission
| eval parse_issue=case(
    missing_id=1,"missing_event_id",
    event_has_grant=0,"missing_grant_properties",
    ambiguous=1,"missing_or_ambiguous_attribution",
    permission="__missing__" OR permission="","missing_permission",
    grant_type="delegated" AND mvcount(consent_type)>1,"ambiguous_consent_type",
    consent_type="__missing__","missing_consent_type",
    true(),"none")
| lookup entra_approved_grants.csv
    client_sp_id resource_sp_id grant_type permission consent_type
    OUTPUT permission AS matched_permission
| eval baseline_status=case(
    parse_issue!="none","parse_error",
    isnotnull(matched_permission),"approved",
    true(),"outside_baseline")
| eval key_consent=mvjoin(mvsort(consent_type),";")
| eval alert_key=sha256(len(event_id).":".event_id.len(client_sp_id).":".client_sp_id.len(resource_sp_id).":".resource_sp_id.len(grant_type).":".grant_type.len(permission).":".permission.len(key_consent).":".key_consent.len(parse_issue).":".parse_issue)
| table _time event_id correlationId actor client_sp_id resource_sp_id resource_name grant_type permission consent_type parse_issue baseline_status alert_key
 | stats count by permission baseline_status parse_issue
